newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice surges limit in closing minutes.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice surges limit in closing minutes.

text.p: CBOT rice futures surged in the waning minutes of trading with the nearby two contracts ending up the 30 cent per cwt trading limit, traders said.
"We know supplies are tight on the farm and this is a result of that," a trader said.
Traders said there was broad-based commission house buying during the close.
Rice Wednesday will trade with expanded 45 cent per cwt trading limits.
Rice closed four to 30 cents per cwt higher, with March up 30 at $11.88 per cwt.
